name: Kaylee Egerer
detail: The Herald of 22 Feb 2011 captions her Campus Improvements Chair, a term the archive does not record. It has her in 2008-09 and 2011-12 only, so her portrait had to be filed to the latter.

name: Paige Settles
detail: Recorded twice in the same year, as Page Settles and Paige Settles, both Speaker of the Senate. One person, two spellings. Her own progression, freshman senator in 2012-13, confirms the Herald was right to call her a senior in September 2015 and wrong to call her a junior the following March.

name: Nolan Miles / Noland Miles
detail: Entered twice in the same year under two spellings, as Chair of Public Relations and Chair of Student Affairs. One man: he is Executive Vice President in 1914-15 and 1915-16 as Nolan. His portrait attaches to the Nolan spelling, so the Noland entry reads as a person with no face and inflates the missing count.

name: Spirit Masters booklets 2011-2018
detail: Called the best untapped portrait source by an earlier researcher. All seven were pulled and searched against the whole missing list. Seventeen name matches, and twelve were different people entirely: Steve Todd served 1969-70 and Scott Taylor 1975-76, neither can be in a 2014 booklet. Of the three whose service plausibly overlapped, not one bio mentions student government. The source is spent; do not mine it again.

name: Carlene and Darlene Lodmell
detail: Two people, not one, despite differing by a single letter. They held office side by side: in 1995-96 Darlene chaired Student Affairs while Carlene chaired Legislative Research, and in 1996-97 Carlene was Vice President while Darlene was Secretary. A name-similarity sweep flags them every time; they must not be merged and neither may wear the other's face. Confirmed independently against the university's own records on 1 September 2026. This is settled and is now recorded in CLAUDE.md.

name: Amanda Allen / Amanda B. Allen
detail: Recorded as Executive Vice President and as Administrative Vice President in the same year, from two different sources. Probably one person whose title one source got wrong, but the two offices are genuinely distinct and nothing settles it, so no portrait was shared between the records.

name: 1989 Talisman, printed pages 352-353
detail: One leaf is missing from the TopSCHOLAR scan of the 1989 Talisman. PDF leaf 178 ends on printed page 351 and leaf 179 opens on printed page 354, so the index runs A to Crawford and then jumps to Foe. The whole D and E section of the index, and the first half of F, is simply not in the file. That is why Bill Engle cannot be looked up in the volume that covers his first year. Every leaf after 178 is therefore one printed spread further on than the arithmetic suggests: pages are 2*leaf-6 up to leaf 178 and 2*leaf-4 after it.

name: TopSCHOLAR Talismans 1982-1991
detail: Every volume of this run is scanned at about 96 dpi, roughly 816 by 1123 pixels per printed page, except the 1983 volume which is 1892 by 2386 and has no OCR text layer at all. At that ceiling a class portrait cell comes out between 70 and 160 pixels wide, which is small but real, while a face in a club or Associated Student Government group photograph comes out at 40 to 60 pixels, which is not usable for anything. Plan on the class portrait grids and treat the group photographs as name lists, not as picture sources. Volume record numbers run 405 for 1982, 406 and 407 for the two parts of 1983, then 408 to 415 for 1984 through 1991. Leaf to printed page: 1982 page = leaf-3; 1983 part 2 page = leaf+193; 1984 and 1991 page = 2*leaf-6; 1985 page = 2*leaf-4; 1988 and 1990 page = leaf-3; 1989 see the entry above.

name: Debby Clark
detail: Two Deborah Clarks sit in the same block of the 1974 Talisman senior grid, and three researchers left her open rather than guess. The disambiguator is Chi Omega, not hometown. The Herald of 6 November 1973 calls the legislative intern an Associated Student Government and Chi Omega member; the 1974 index puts Chi Omega on p. 259 and indexes only Deborah Kelly Clark there, Janca appearing on 248, 311 and 350. The grid prints them as DEBORAH J. CLARK, Elem. Ed., Campbellsville and DEBORAH K. CLARK, Admin. Services, Bowling Green. Hers is the second face in the third row. Do not reopen without a source that puts a different Clark in the office.
